name: Wrong Number non-realtime counterpart
transformation: The donor's moving carrier phase is held at its generated phase offset until the player deliberately starts the finite lock test; trial duration, sampling, retry regeneration, and failure consequences are preserved.
counterpart_rule: No autonomous phase evolution occurs while awaiting line selection, tuning, or test start. The finite post-action lock test still samples for the donor-configured duration, but its signal target is static.
